title: incident-bot: targeted runbook linking and context-aware diagnostics for on-call helpers
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Add contextual runbook linking and diagnostic hints for the incident-bot on-call helper. Improves runbook relevance scoring and emits telemetry for SLO-linked diagnostics.
description:
Motivation: on-call responders regularly ask for runbooks that are most relevant to the current SLO context and error signals. This PR adds targeted runbook linking to incident-bot and enhances the slo-toolkit helpers with context-aware diagnostics so suggestions better match the active alert.

What this changes: implements a context scoring pipeline that combines SLO metadata, alert tags, recent error fingerprints, and playbook ratings to rank runbooks. Adds a new lightweight diagnostics generator that returns a prioritized checklist (top 3) for on-call responders and surfaces quick links to relevant runbook sections. Includes a feature flag to enable gradual rollout and safety checks to avoid leaking sensitive internal links in cross-tenant messages.

Checklist: - [x] Implement runbook scoring heuristic and caching layer - [x] Expose new API /v1/oncall/runbook-suggestions - [x] Add unit and integration tests for scoring and diagnostics - [x] Add telemetry events (runbook_suggested, runbook_clicked, diagnostics_generated) - [x] Feature-flag gated rollout (env: INCIDENT_BOT_RUNBOOK_SUGGESTIONS) - [x] Docs update and examples in README - [x] Add E2E smoke test in perf-canary harness

Backward compatibility & rollout: The change is behind a feature flag and defaults to disabled for customers that have not opted in. Existing API surfaces remain unchanged; new endpoint is additive. Monitoring dashboards added to redwood-console to track suggestion CTR and false-positive feedback.

Testing notes: Unit tests added for ranking logic and caching edge cases. Integration tests mock SLO metadata and alert payloads to validate end-to-end suggestion flow. CI initially flagged flaky e2e (timing-sensitive tests); the tests were stabilized by increasing retry backoff and those checks passed on rerun.

Related work: ENG-4521 (runbook UX improvements), ENG-4628 (slo-toolkit heuristics). SUP-1987 notes an incident where runbook suggestions returned unrelated docs; this PR addresses that gap.

Deployment: Deploy safe rollout to staging, enable feature flag for SRE team, monitor telemetry for 48h, then enable for a small subset of customers before global rollout.

review_comments: Ariana Chen: Please add a unit test for the tag-mismatch fallback path; otherwise LGTM.
Priya Raman: Added test for tag-mismatch and updated fallback to prefer playbook ratings when tags are sparse.
Marcus Lee: Noting a potential privacy risk when runbook links include internal-only paths. Can we sanitize links for external tenants?
Priya Raman: Feature-flag and tenant-scope checks added; links are now sanitized and internal links are omitted unless tenant_is_internal == true.
Ben Carter: Integration tests are flaky in CI; saw a timeout in canary harness. Increased backoff and retried; all green now. Approving.
notes_for_ops: Enable INCIDENT_BOT_RUNBOOK_SUGGESTIONS=false by default. To test, set to true for a single tenant. Watch metrics: observability.runbook_suggestions.ctr, observability.runbook_suggestions.fp_rate. Rollback by toggling flag off.
